items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: I was an admirer of Louis Armstrong

ctx.x: Okay. But what did that have — or didn’t they have anything in particular? Did they have — you know what I think my question is —
Well actually you know the LP came out at that time. And we had George Avakian’s, Louis Armstrong’s Hot Five, Hot Sevens, on the Columbia green label.
Okay. The non-jazz music that they might have been listening to was what?
